page_title: RMA 4-0 OSA | Real Madrid v Osasuna 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' The current number of shots on goal is 8:1.
87' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
84' Joselu (Real Madrid) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the middle of the target, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a save.
84' Joselu (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
83' Kike Barja (Osasuna) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
83' The referee is firm and issues David Garcia (Osasuna) a deserved yellow card.
83' David Garcia (Osasuna) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Real Madrid are awarded a penalty!
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Madrid comes to nothing.
80' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Here's the change. Ruben Pena leaves the pitch and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
80' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Aimar Oroz is replaced by Raul (Osasuna).
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jon Moncayola will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Carvajal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
79' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Luka Modric will be replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
78' Close! Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
75' Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Sergio Herrera.
72' Substitution. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) replaces Vinicius Junior.
72' Substitution. Jude Bellingham will be replaced by Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid).
70' A substitution has been made. Ruben Garcia goes off and Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) comes on.
70' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Ante Budimir and he is replaced by Chimy Avila (Osasuna).

70' 4 - 0 Goal! Vinicius Junior displays great vision and sends a pass to Joselu (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 4:0.
67' Here comes a substitution. Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Eduardo Camavinga.
65' 3 - 0 Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Sergio Herrera with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
63' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents.
62' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
59' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.

54' 2 - 0 Goal! Federico Valverde manages to prod the ball to Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
54' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
48' Joselu (Real Madrid) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Wonderful movement by Real Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
43' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
40' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) picks up a yellow card.
40' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
39' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
37' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
35' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
31' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' The ball is cleared after Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar.
24' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' The possession of the ball – 68:32.
17' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
13' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
11' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Daniel Carvajal provides Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 1:0.
7' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
5' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
